title: NOTICE REGARDING ARRAIGNMENT OF BAIL MATTERS DURING THE SUMMER VACATION-2026
text:
KEY LINES:
05/05/2026

FULL TEXT:
NOTICE
As
directed
by
the Hon’ble the Chief
Justice,
all
the
Learned
Advocates,
Litigants,
Party-in-person
and
Stakeholders
are
hereby
informed
that:
1.
Additional
Vacation
Benches
(Criminal)
will
be
constituted during the
Summer
Vacation
to
exclusively
hear
bail
matters
of
all
categories, including
both
freshly
filed
and
adjourned
cases.
2. All left
over
Bail
matters
will
be
listed
before the
Additional
Vacation
Benches
(Criminal)
taking
up
Bail
matters.
3. All
freshly
filed
Bail
matters
of
all
Categories
shall
be
listed
before the
Additional
Vacation
Benches
(Criminal)
directly
without
raising
issue of
urgency.
By
order
of
the Hon’ble
Chief Justice
Hawes
Date
:
05/05/2026
Régistrar
(Judicial)
